screen.outside: The place lies outside Buienradar's map
screen.name: Buienradar

app.place_hint: Where the rain is for: your home zone, another zone, or a person, whose rain follows them. Its coordinates go to Buienradar rounded to about a kilometre.
app.name: Buienradar
app.summary: Rain for the next two hours at your place, as Buienradar's graph and its radar map.
app.latitude_hint: Only for a place other than the one above: its latitude, such as 52.09. Fill in both, or leave both empty.
app.map_hint: On a tile of 3x2, 2x3 or larger, a large 2x2, and on the card. A smaller tile shows the graph alone.
app.graph_hint: Off: a tile of 2x2 or larger shows the moving radar map alone, as large as it fits. The graph stays on the card a tap opens, and on a screen without pictures.
app.play_hint: Which frames the tile's map plays by itself.
app.pace_hint: Seconds each frame of the map stays on the tile.
app.setting_bar_when_hint: When the top bar item shows: always, when rain is coming in the next two hours, or when it starts within half an hour. It says what the screen's Rain radar tile knows, so the screen needs that tile too.
app.setting_bar_words_hint: The moment as a clock time (Dry until 14:05) or in minutes (Rain in 20 min).
